contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' contributions, line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED = 11,035.47 on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE - repeated at summary lines 4 and 5, and equal to Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' $11,035.47 and 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' $11,035.47
contributions.detail: 9 Schedule A rows sum to 3750 + 20 + 100 + 185 + 150 + 250 + 30 + 4500 + 2050.47 = 11,035.47 exactly, matching all four printed anchors. THREE of the nine rows are the candidate's own money (3,750 + 4,500 + 2,050.47 = 10,300.47 of the 11,035.47): they are itemized contribution rows here because line 3 Balance at Beginning is a slashed ZERO, leaving no beginning-balance slot, and the side closes only with them - the loan/self-funding ladder run per the standing rule, not decided by the word used. Column B Year-to-Date prints the SAME 11,035.47, which is not a cumulative-exact case: this is the cycle's first report so period IS year-to-date. Nothing was differenced across filings.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' expenditures, line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE = 11,035.47 on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE - repeated at summary line 6, and equal to the 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' $11,035.47 printed identically at the foot of BOTH Schedule B sheets
expenditures.detail: TWO Schedule B pages, each gated by its own printed page subtotal. p4's 17 rows sum to 3,913.54 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page' $3,913.54. p5's 16 rows sum to 7,121.93 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page' $7121.93. 3,913.54 + 7,121.93 = 11,035.47 = the printed grand total on both sheets = the cover's promoted per-period cell (line 2 Column A) = summary line 6. 33 rows, and every one of the three page-level gates closes to the cent. The balance ladder also closes: line 3 slashed-zero 0 + line 4 11,035.47 = line 5 11,035.47, minus line 6 11,035.47 = line 7 slashed-zero 0.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closed exactly on BOTH sides (11,035.47 each). Both conventions tested and identical here: no schedule prints an in-kind column, the summary page prints no in-kind line, and no row is marked in kind - although note that many expenditure rows are REIMBURSEMENTS to the candidate for goods he bought, which the filer books as cash expenditures, not as in-kind.
itemized.escalation_note: Ten 900 dpi tight-cell crops, all for GEOMETRY PROOF; none was needed to settle a figure - this filer writes in large crisp block capitals and every amount is legible at full-page resolution. TWO crops were discarded and re-taken: the first attempt at the p3 last-row control was measured two bands too low and rendered EMPTY, which is exactly the failure mode the control exists to catch; the corrected band rendered the recorded value. What each surviving crop rendered is recorded in the frames' measure_notes.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'RAPHAEL MILLET' - index.csv names NO filer for this row, so the page face fills an empty channel label. ⚠ NAME SPELLING: the page face spells it MILLET (one t) on the cover, in the signature and in the last-name box of all four inner sheets, while the county's filename and reporting-period label spell it MILLETT (raw/2014/2014_30DayMillett_2.pdf, '30 Day Recorder - Millett'). The page face governs; this is the third clerk-name drift observed in this chunk (with Guernsey/Gurnsey) and the same class as the module's Farren/Farron and Bird/Baird cases. Page-face office 'RECORDER', agreeing with the channel's 'County Recorder'. Report type ticked '30 Days after withdraw or elimination'; party 'REPUBLICAN'; date 5/12/2014; clerk stamp 'MAY 12 AM 10:28'. ⚠ THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS LEFT WHOLLY UNANSWERED - neither Yes nor No is ticked. That is an honest BLANK and was NOT read as 'No' (the §A4 precedent). FIVE pages: p1 the 2014 cover (Utah County Code 2-5) / p2 SUMMARY PAGE / p3 SCHEDULE A / p4 SCHEDULE B / p5 a SECOND SCHEDULE B, each classified from its own printed heading. FOLIATION: the filer numbers the four inner sheets '1 of 4' .. '4 of 4', EXCLUDING the cover - the §A4 convention, and the reason no page ordinal was used to locate the summary page. Summary lines 3 and 7 are SLASHED ZEROS (0 under the zero-glyph ruling) and every other summary cell carries a real figure. SOURCE PROPERTY worth carrying: this filer solves the missing Purpose column in TWO ways on one filing - appending the purpose to the payee in the 'Name of Contributor' cell (most rows), and, on four consecutive p4 rows, INVERTING THE FIELDS ENTIRELY: the purpose goes in the payee column and the payee ('BCR Political') in the address column. A parser keyed on column position would emit 'Website use of domain name registration' as a vendor on those rows. He also books most small purchases as REIMBURSEMENTS TO HIMSELF, writing his own name and address alongside the vendor's name, and repeatedly strikes his own name out and rewrites the true payee above the line - handwritten corrections over struck values govern and were followed. PRIVACY: this filing is UNREDACTED; every donor's full street line is legible on p3 and none was carried - city/state only. The two heavy ink strikes on p4 are the FILER's own corrections, not clerk redactions.
